rows.name: Big Wave Shrimp
rows.notes: The business's own site describes a daily Haleiwa food truck with pickup or online ordering for its Lemon Pepper Shrimp, but I could not see the order link itself. Third-party sources give 66-521 Kamehameha Hwy and 10am-6:30pm daily; these are not stated on the site excerpt I saw. A 2026 guide and an Oct 2026 article still list the truck. No Instagram or Facebook account could be tied to this business from the results, so both are null.

rows.name: D's Steak Truck
rows.notes: The handle @dssteaktruck comes from a Honolulu Star-Advertiser feature (Nov 2025). The same article says the truck is at Kahuku Sugar Mill, 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy, open daily 11am-6pm. It also says a Friday special plate is usually posted on Instagram. Orders are by call or text to 808-298-2945; no order URL found. The article mentions a planned Waikiki location. No own website or Facebook page found. Schedule is fixed daily, so I left schedule_source_url null.

rows.name: Da Bald Guy
rows.notes: A Kahuku Sugar Mill food truck at 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy. Aggregators say it runs Mon-Sat and that the owner makes his own social media content, but none of the results gave his handles or website. Instagram, Facebook and website are therefore null. A TikTok discover page was updated in July 2026 and shows recent creator posts about the truck, so it appears active. I did not use review sites.

rows.name: Da Brazilian Braddahs
rows.notes: Sources conflict. Several list a Kahuku truck (56-565 or 56-580 Kamehameha Hwy, phone 808-388-1338). One aggregator lists a Waianae/Makaha truck (84-889 Farrington Hwy, phone 808-892-9569). A YouTube video also describes a Makaha truck run by someone named Alex. These may be different operators or a relocation. No official website or social accounts were found, so activity could not be confirmed.

rows.name: Del-icious Burgers
rows.notes: Owner Del Galicinao runs a food truck in Mililani Tech Park, 200 Akamainui St (a Star-Advertiser feature from 2021). KITV (2025) also covered it. Some aggregators write the name 'Del-icious Burgers Hawai'i' and give 233 Akamainui St, with days of Mon/Wed/Fri. I could not confirm that against an own page. No official website or social handles found. The latest independent confirmation is from 2025, so I could not confirm it is currently active.

rows.name: Eat My Meat
rows.notes: The Instagram handle @eatmymeat.official comes from a May 2025 Star-Advertiser feature. It describes the lime-green truck run by owner Minh Nguyen at Mililani Technology Park, 100 Kahelu Ave, Mon-Fri, plus island events. The Facebook page eatmymeathi lists 2829 Awaawaloa St, Honolulu, phone 808-837-0098, and the website eatmymeathi.com. A second Facebook page, facebook.com/eatmymeathawaii/, has the same address and phone. I could not confirm that the Mililani and Honolulu entries are the same business. The latest independent confirmation is May 2025, so activity is unconfirmed. Orders are by phone or Instagram per the article.

rows.name: Eighty Chicken Sandwiches
rows.notes: The handle @eightychickensandwiches comes from the Honolulu Magazine feature, which is a few years old. A weekend-only trailer at 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku, with about 80 sandwiches a day, typically noon-3pm Sat/Sun per aggregators. Aggregator listings with Feb 2026 reviews suggest it is still operating. I found no own website or Facebook page, and the schedule is not confirmed by an own source.

rows.name: Famous Kahuku Shrimp
rows.notes: The Facebook URL comes from an Apple Maps business listing. The website comes from structured data on a MapQuest listing. I could not open either to confirm. Listings give 56-565 Kamehameha Hwy (some say 56-580), 10am-6pm daily, phone 808-389-1173 (another listing shows 808-427-5541). A Kahuku shrimp truck guide from Oct 2026 still lists it. No Instagram found.

rows.name: Fasay Thai Wagon
rows.notes: A Thai food truck near the Kahuku Sugar Mill, phone 808-554-6674, with listed hours of 10:30am-8pm daily. It is also described as 'also known as Thong's Thai'. Addresses vary: 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Burroughs Rd, or just Kahuku. No official site or social accounts were found. The active status rests only on 2026 aggregator listings.

rows.name: Flyin' Ahi
rows.notes: The Star-Advertiser (Oct 2025) names @flyinahi and says daily specials are posted there. The Facebook page lists 200 Akamainui St, flyinahi@gmail.com and 808-291-4633, and shows a post about a closure, so it also carries schedule notices. The truck is at Mililani Tech Park, 11am-1:30pm Tue-Fri. The owner also opened a Kaneohe brick-and-mortar location, so this is a second site and not a replacement for the truck. Tripadvisor shows a website field but gave no URL, so website is null. In-person ordering only per the article.

rows.name: Giovanni's Original White Shrimp Truck
rows.notes: The Instagram and Facebook links come from the sameAs data on the official site. A separate Facebook page, 'Giovanni's Original Shrimp Truck', lists 56-505 Kamehameha Hwy, Kahuku, info@giovannisshrimptruck.com and the same site. The website lists Kahuku (56-505 Kamehameha Hwy), Haleʻiwa and Kakaʻako locations. I took the seed to mean the Kahuku truck. A map listing gives 10:30am-6:30pm daily, with phone 808-293-1839; this was not confirmed on the site excerpt. Other sources say the truck is cash-heavy. No order URL found.

rows.name: Haleiwa Bowls
rows.notes: The Facebook page is titled 'Hale'iwa Bowls', describes acai bowls and smoothies, and says it is owned by a few locals of Oahu. The Instagram handle @haleiwabowls comes from a travel-site caption that places it on the North Shore. I did not see the account itself. No own website found. Street address varies by source (66-030, 66-081 and 66-082 Kamehameha Hwy), so I left it out. Other sources describe a thatched shack in Haleʻiwa town, and a 2026 travel listing and a guide from about 11 months ago still list it.

rows.name: Happy Rico
rows.notes: The handle @happy_rrrico (three r's) comes from a Star-Advertiser feature (Apr 2025). The May 2026 Star-Advertiser piece says Mehana St, Kaneohe, noon-6pm Thu/Fri, and in front of Bellows Air Force Station, Waimanalo, on weekends (an earlier 2025 article gave 11am-4pm). Phone 787-666-9529; orders in person, by phone or via Instagram. I did not open the Instagram, so I could not confirm it is where the schedule is posted. No own website or Facebook found.

rows.name: Haveli Da Tandoor
rows.notes: Several news outlets (KHON, Hawaii News Now, Star-Advertiser, Aloha State Daily) give @havelihi, and one gives the Square site, as the business's own channels. HNN says the truck posts its upcoming location every Sunday on Instagram. It is a mobile truck with no fixed base. Events named include the 'What the Truck' night market at Pearl Ridge, Village Night Market at Pearlridge, and Ono Grindz & Makeke at Wai Kai. The seed's Leeward/West label is not confirmed by any source. The Square site may support ordering, but that was not stated, so order_url is null. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Impossibles Pizza
rows.notes: I did not find any sources for this vendor because I ran out of searches. All fields are null. This is not a finding that the business has no online presence.
